description:
Configure the 'Form Defaults' for Sales Invoices in the Northwind Traders business to enforce standard settings. 

Goal: Ensure that every NEW sales invoice automatically starts with:
1. Custom Title: 'TAX INVOICE'
2. Due Date: 'Net 14 days'
3. Notes: 'Payment is due within 14 days. Please include invoice number in transfer reference.'

Starting State: Manager.io is open at the Sales Invoices list. You must find the 'Form Defaults' button (usually at the bottom of the screen or in settings) to apply these global changes.

metadata.expected_notes_snippet: include invoice number in transfer reference
